active_capsule.content: FreetoShop long-horizon engineering goal received. The task is to implement a local-first browser image editor with Photoshop-familiar workflows while preserving the existing tiled architecture. Six milestones defined: (1) Clone Stamp foundation, (2) Retouch/paint workflow completion, (3) Selection/transform/adjustment/layer workflows, (4) Local-first persistence/partial documents/recovery, (5) Rendering/format compatibility, (6) Professional shell/compatibility/hardening. Cross-cutting acceptance contract requires every pixel-changing feature to define edit target, coordinate space, bounded region, error handling, command/history boundary, and persistence/recovery behavior. Repository structure explored: monorepo with apps/web, packages, tests, docs directories. Key documentation files identified including ARCHITECTURE.md, DOCUMENT_MODEL.md, IMPLEMENTATION_ROADMAP.md, BENCHMARKS.md, TESTING.md. Next step: read ARCHITECTURE.md and DOCUMENT_MODEL.md to understand existing tiled architecture before implementing Milestone 1 (Clone Stamp).
